name: Arrow of Vengeance (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 3, inquisitor 4, lathspell 3, paladin 3, ranger 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Effect one attack
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

Witnessing an ally in need, you make a sign in the air marking an oath of vengeance and loose a deadly attack.

When an ally is attacked within the first range increment of a ranged weapon you are currently wielding you may cast this spell. When you cast it you immediately make a single attack against the enemy who attacked your ally, if the attack hits it is automatically a critical threat and deals additional damage equal to your Wisdom or Charisma bonus, whichever is higher.
